notes:
The PPSSPP controller bug is fixed.

If your controller connected in PPSSPP but no button did anything, this was the cause.
The launcher was creating PPSSPP's control settings file before PPSSPP had ever run,
and PPSSPP only sets up its default controls when it finds no settings of its own. So
on a console where PPSSPP had never been opened, it started with nothing mapped at all,
and no later launch ever repaired it. Your controller was fine the whole time.

Your console repairs itself the next time you start a PSP game. One thing to expect:
that first launch gives you your buttons back, and the launcher's own shortcuts (save
state, load state, screenshot, reset) return on the launch after. Start the game once,
quit, and start it again, and everything is in place.
